0022600024.text: The Phoenix Suns host the Denver Nuggets in the fourth game of the Suns' season and an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A matchup. Phoenix is 1-2, 11th in the West and 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, and has lost its last game, with a 1-0 home record and an 0-2 road record. Denver is also 1-2 and on a one-game losing streak, sitting 10th in the West and 4th in the Northwest, 2.5 games back. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix with a shoulder injury following surgery, and Oso Ighodaro is day-to-day with an oblique strain and is a game-time decision. Denver will be without Alpha Diallo (personal reasons), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and the teams have not met yet this season. Phoenix lost all three meetings with Denver in 2025-26, most recently a 125-123 loss at home on March 24, 2026.
